name: delete_help
prompt: How do I stop a proposed deletion, and does asking for a deletion preview already erase the report? Explain only; do not run anything.
expected: Explain cancellation, preview is non-destructive and exact confirmation; no state change.

answer.text: Request a deletion preview to see matching reports in your own library. Nothing is deleted until you use /confirm with the exact preview token. You can cancel pending deletion in this conversation by asking me or using /cancel. This explanation did not prepare or execute deletion.
